text.title: Stakeholder Management Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Stakeholder Management. Required because complexity=medium. Each step has input / action / output and (where applicable) a decision-gate. Then the four-step identification-to-execution process.

step.name: check-preconditions
step.input: `## Applies If` items, `## Skip If` items, prior-cycle artefact (if any).
step.action: Verify ALL applies-if items hold and NO skip-if item fires.
step.output: boolean `proceed`; if false, log skip reason and exit.
step.decision-gate: If `proceed == false`, conclude with `skip-this-methodology` and stop.

step.name: gather-inputs
step.action: Pull each input artefact from its named source; verify freshness (e.g., ≤7 days where applicable).
step.output: structured input bundle ready for step 3.
step.decision-gate: If any input missing or stale, defer the cycle and record the gap.

step.name: apply-core-rules
step.action: Apply each testable rule in order; record any rule violation with concrete evidence.

step.name: produce-artefact
step.action: Render the artefact (shape defined by JSON Schema in `02-output-contract.xml`).

step.name: validate-and-route
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-stakeholder-management.py` against the artefact. On pass, route to downstream consumer; on fail, surface violations.
step.output: validator exit code 0 (pass) or 1 (fail) + violation list.
step.decision-gate: If exit != 0, return artefact for revision; do not advance.

step.name: identify
step.input: Org chart, CODEOWNERS, meeting notes, customer list.
step.action: Step 1 — Identify: who uses, pays, approves, builds, supports, or could block this product
step.output: candidate stakeholder rows with a cited source each (rule cite-source-per-classification).

step.name: analyze
step.action: Step 2 — Analyze: what they want, what they fear, power level, interest level, attitude
step.output: register rows per rule register-columns-with-owner; attitude never blank (rule attitude-column-never-blank).

step.name: plan-engagement
step.action: Step 3 — Plan engagement: cadence, format, information they need, relationship owner
step.output: communication plan per rules cadence-never-ad-hoc and escalation-path-named-people.

step.name: execute-and-adapt
step.action: Step 4 — Execute and adapt: regular touchpoints, track attitude shifts, handle conflicts proactively
step.output: updated register at roadmap cadence (rule register-review-with-roadmap-cadence).
step.decision-gate: If a Partner-tier stakeholder is absent from the decision log for a month, propose a downgrade for human approval (rules register-paired-with-decision-log, agent-never-downgrades-engagement).
